mapper.select: /** SignUpMapper.countByUserId */ SELECT COUNT(M.id) FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.userId = #{userId}
/** SignUpMapper.countByPhone */ SELECT COUNT(M.id) FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.phone = #{phone}
/** SignUpMapper.countByEmail */ SELECT COUNT(M.id) FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.email = #{email}
mapper.insert: /** SignUpMapper.insertMember */ INSERT INTO MEMBER( userId, password, name, birth, gender, phone, email, nation, postNumber, address, addressDetail, createDate, isActive, isTempPassword, isAdmin ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{birth}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{nation}, #{postNumber}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, now(), 1, 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM MEMBER WHERE userId = #{userId}
mapper.insert: /** SignUpMapper.insertTermsOfUseMembers */ INSERT INTO TERMS_OF_USE_MEMBERS ( termsOfUseId, memberId, isAgree, createMemberId, createDate ) VALUES ( #{termsOfUseId}, #{memberId}, #{agree}, #{memberId}, now() )
